doc: The M3 menus' UI sounds (M3-AUD-15; assets_src/sfx/menu_sfx.py; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Menus"). Same row format as sfx.json; AudioData.sfx_rows merges this file in. All on the UI bus at -20 LUFS momentary max. ui_sfx.json's hooks play them by listening: the Lattice page (LatticeMenu: a node woken, a gate opened, a walk), Equip (EquipMenu: a piece worn or taken off, a craft), the zone map (ZoneMapMenu / ZoneMapView: open, close, the legend's tick, a place clicked), the tip card (TipCard: fade-in) and the title (TitleMenu: the first swell, Begin / Continue). Those menus are on claude/ui and claude/menus, not here yet, so their hooks are pending; the title's are live.

ui_hand_found._note: M4-AUD-1080: the reader's found hand, the same bar struck twice (assets_src/sfx/act2_ui_sfx.py)

ui_mark._note: M4-AUD-1080: a mark set, moved or cleared in the reader: a pen's stroke (assets_src/sfx/act2_ui_sfx.py)
